assumptions: Synthetic aggregate coefficients, not demographic/engineering norms
Water is an external boundary supply; deposits and initial assets/stocks are explicit
Training places represent consenting eligible capacity, not people owned or traded
Qualified capacity and equipment are shared use limits, not consumed ingredients
Public asset procurement is paid only for completed equipment/buildings
Input payments follow actual consumption; incomplete work ties up opening working measure
Natural resources and people have zero commodity price in this example
All monetary norms fixed; no interest, tax, loan or later issuance
Actual missing provision remains recorded; no claim that missing goods cancel human entitlements
Money is prefunded using exact schedule bounds, not optimized globally
Trimmed cases are retrospective fixed-delivery improvements, not causal forecasts or global optima
Recovery decisions use current observed capacities, stocks and committed output; no future outage duration is provided
Reserve routes take two periods and four shared equipment/skill units per batch; synthetic capacity is declared in every comparison
The original terminal stock is a lower bound in trimmed cases; all intermediate safety-stock policy remains open
Energy/fuel/material quantities are abstract recipe units, not measured kWh/tonnes; external water left unused is reported separately from energy discard
Inventory age/expiry, health demography, individual choice, teacher specializations and foreign trade remain open
Heuristic is not a global optimum except when a valid stated objective certificate exists

assumptions: Autonomy sizing uses 220 fuel units per cohort-period plus two restart periods
Daily fuel loss is 1000 ppm rounded up; not a measured fuel property
Generator and storage construction each require 10 metal plus 10 energy and 30 periods
One generator permits 10 backup batches per period; one storage unit holds 1000 additional fuel units
Backup conversion has the same declared fuel/water recipe as primary generation; constructed redundancy is paid as capital
Restart floor is protected from backup dispatch, not exempt from physical storage loss
The experiment is not food-expiry modelling or a guarantee against unlimited starvation
No new money is issued during any replay; every physical shortage remains visible
reserve_lifecycle.scope_note: prepared family excludes preconstruction failure and supply interruptions beyond 30 periods; all remain reported
